raw_text: Apple scab is caused by Venturia inaequalis, a fungal pathogen. Early symptoms: olive-green spots on young leaves. Symptoms: dark scabby lesions on fruit; distorted leaves. Conditions: 12 to 24 C, wet leaves, rain, high humidity. Severity is high in susceptible cultivars during prolonged wet weather. Organic treatment: sulfur. Prevention: prune for airflow; remove fallen leaves; plant resistant cultivars.
